nodes.name: GitHub Webhook
nodes.notes: One webhook fans out to three folder filters (TASKS/, OUTPUT/approved/, RESULTS/). Single file per push (single-writer). Obsidian Sync -> GitHub push chains the transitions.

nodes.name: Filter Task Files
nodes.notes: Keeps the first TASKS/*.md file. Halts if none.

nodes.name: Read Task File
nodes.notes: Obsidian GET -> raw markdown of the task note.

nodes.name: Merge Task Content
nodes.notes: Merges read markdown into file_content.

nodes.name: Gate 1 — Sanitize (Task)
nodes.notes: Gate 1: blocks injection patterns in the task note.

nodes.name: Agent 1 · Task Analyzer
nodes.notes: Agent 1. Structured outputs; thinking disabled to protect the 5000-token budget.

nodes.name: Gate 2 — Validate Spec
nodes.notes: Gate 2: pending-review path boundary + non-empty steps/criteria.

parameters.value: ={{ JSON.stringify({ agent_name: 'task-analyzer', task_file: $('Filter Task Files').first().json.file_path, output_file: $json.spec_file, commit_hash: $('Filter Task Files').first().json.commit_hash, status: 'pending', token_count: $('Agent 1 · Task Analyzer').first().json.usage?.output_tokens || 0 }) }}

nodes.name: Write Audit — Task Analyzer
nodes.notes: Supabase audit: agent=task-analyzer, status=pending.

nodes.name: Format SPEC Markdown
nodes.notes: Renders SPEC.md (reads the Gate node by name, not position).

nodes.name: Write SPEC (Obsidian)
nodes.notes: Obsidian PUT -> OUTPUT/pending-review/SPEC_*.md. Human moves to approved/ to advance.

nodes.name: Filter Approved Files
nodes.notes: Keeps the first OUTPUT/approved/*.md file. Halts if none.

nodes.name: Read Approved File
nodes.notes: Obsidian GET -> raw markdown of the approved spec.

nodes.name: Merge Approved Content
nodes.notes: Merges read markdown into file_content.

nodes.name: Gate 1 — Sanitize (Approved)
nodes.notes: Gate 1: blocks injection patterns in the approved spec.

nodes.name: Agent 2 · Spec Generator
nodes.notes: Agent 2. Structured outputs. Triggered by a file moved to OUTPUT/approved/.

nodes.name: Gate 2 — Validate Plan
nodes.notes: Gate 2: RESULTS/ path boundary + non-empty plan steps + rollback required.

parameters.value: ={{ JSON.stringify({ agent_name: 'spec-generator', task_file: $('Filter Approved Files').first().json.file_path, output_file: $json.result_file, commit_hash: $('Filter Approved Files').first().json.commit_hash, status: 'approved', token_count: $('Agent 2 · Spec Generator').first().json.usage?.output_tokens || 0 }) }}

nodes.name: Write Audit — Spec Generator
nodes.notes: Supabase audit: agent=spec-generator, status=approved.

nodes.name: Format Plan Markdown
nodes.notes: Renders PLAN.md for RESULTS/.

nodes.name: Write PLAN (Obsidian)
nodes.notes: Obsidian PUT -> RESULTS/PLAN_*.md. This write triggers the Validator lane.

nodes.name: Filter Result Files
nodes.notes: Keeps the first RESULTS/*.md file, EXCLUDING RESULTS/reports/ (loop guard).

nodes.name: Read Result File
nodes.notes: Obsidian GET -> raw markdown of the result/plan under review.

nodes.name: Merge Result Content
nodes.notes: Merges read markdown into file_content.

nodes.name: Gate 1 — Sanitize (Result)
nodes.notes: Gate 1: blocks injection patterns in the result file.

nodes.name: Agent 3 · Validator
nodes.notes: Agent 3. Structured outputs. Triggered by a new file in RESULTS/.

nodes.name: Gate 2 — Validate Report
nodes.notes: Gate 2: RESULTS/ path boundary + at least one reason.

parameters.value: ={{ JSON.stringify({ agent_name: 'validator', task_file: $('Filter Result Files').first().json.file_path, output_file: $json.result_file, commit_hash: $('Filter Result Files').first().json.commit_hash, status: ($json.status === 'VALIDATED' ? 'approved' : 'rejected'), token_count: $('Agent 3 · Validator').first().json.usage?.output_tokens || 0 }) }}

nodes.name: Write Audit — Validator
nodes.notes: Supabase audit: agent=validator, status derived from VALIDATED/REJECTED.

nodes.name: Format Validation Markdown
nodes.notes: Renders the report to RESULTS/reports/*.validation.md (excluded from the filter).

nodes.name: Write Validation (Obsidian)
nodes.notes: Obsidian PUT -> RESULTS/reports/*.validation.md. Does NOT re-trigger the Validator.

nodes.name: Agent 4 · Auditor
nodes.notes: Agent 4. Structured outputs. Runs after the Validator on any RESULTS/ commit.

nodes.notes: Parses the Auditor JSON before the final Supabase write.

nodes.name: Write Audit — Auditor
nodes.notes: Supabase audit: agent=auditor, final commit-scoped record.

nodes.name: Error Handler
nodes.notes: Catches thrown errors from any read/merge/gate/agent/write node and logs status=error.

agents: Agent 1 (Task Analyzer): TASKS/*.md -> SPEC in OUTPUT/pending-review/ (5000 tok).
Agent 2 (Spec Generator): OUTPUT/approved/*.md -> PLAN in RESULTS/ (8000 tok).
Agent 3 (Validator): RESULTS/*.md -> report in RESULTS/reports/ (3000 tok).
Agent 4 (Auditor): after the Validator on RESULTS/ commits -> Supabase audit summary (2000 tok).
_notes.obsidian_io: Each lane READS its file via Obsidian Local REST API (GET /vault/{path}) into file_content, and WRITES its output via PUT /vault/{path}. This is the concrete transport for the spec's "Obsidian MCP bridge" layer. Requires OBSIDIAN_API_URL + OBSIDIAN_API_KEY.
_notes.loop_guard: Validator reports are written to RESULTS/reports/, which the Filter Result Files node excludes, so a report never re-triggers the Validator. Agent 2 writing a PLAN to RESULTS/ intentionally triggers the Validator.
_notes.structured_outputs: All four agents use output_config.format (json_schema) on claude-sonnet-5 with thinking disabled; Gate 2 nodes enforce only business rules + write-path boundaries.
env_vars_required: OBSIDIAN_API_URL — Obsidian Local REST API base (e.g. https://127.0.0.1:27124)
OBSIDIAN_API_KEY — Obsidian Local REST API bearer token
github_webhook_setup: 1. Vault repo on GitHub > Settings > Webhooks > Add webhook
4. Secret: openssl rand -hex 32 -> store as N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET
